'''Senya Tirall's lightsaber''' was a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] wielded by [[Senya Tirall]], the former [[Knights of Zakuul|Knight of Zakuul]].

==History==
The [[Knights of Zakuul]] traditionally wielded [[lightsaber pike]]s along with heavy shields. The [[Knight-Captain]] [[Senya Tirall]] however frequently utilized a traditional [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] instead of her pike.<ref name="KOTFEchapter5" /> Senya fought with this lightsaber against the [[Nathema Zealot]]s during her failed attempt to rescue her daughter from [[Nathema]].<ref name="Betrayed">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/star-wars-old-republic-–-knights-eternal-throne-–-‘betrayed’-trailer|text="Betrayed"|int=Betrayed}}</ref> She abandoned the Knights of Zakuul after the [[Scion massacre]], but kept both of her weapons close at hand.<ref name="KOTFEchapter6">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=6}}</ref>

[[File:Senya_with_lightsaber.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Senya wields her lightsaber in a battle.]]
Senya allied herself with [[Lana Beniko]] and came to her aid during the [[rescue of the Outlander]], wielding her lightsaber against her fellow Knights and [[skytrooper]]s that were attacking the ''[[Gravestone]]''.<ref name="KOTFEchapter5" /> After the escape, Senya went with the others to [[Asylum]] where she joined the [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]] in a trial organized by [[Heskal]], fighting to get closer to the truth the Scions had offered.<ref name="KOTFEchapter6" /> Senya also accompanied the Outlander to the [[Old World]] of [[Zakuul]], using her lightsaber against the [[Heralds of Zildrog]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=7}}</ref> During the [[Battle of Asylum]] Senya dueled her own daughter [[Vaylin]] and gained an upper hand, but had to flee instead of settling the matter.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=7}}</ref>

[[File:Vaylin_disarmed.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Senya points her lightsaber at Vaylin after disarming her.]]
After joining the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] to put an end to her childrens' reign of terror, Senya wielded her lightsaber during a [[Mission to Zakuul listening post|diversionary strike]] to provide cover for the [[Havoc Squad]].<ref name="KOTFEchapter11" /> During the [[GEMINI trap|attempt to overtake the GEMINI frequency]], Senya fought through waves of skytroopers and other threats aboard an [[Eternal Fleet warship]], eventually fighting its [[Unidentified GEMINI captain|GEMINI captain]] face-to-face.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=15}}</ref> During the [[Battle of Odessen]] Senya rescued her son [[Arcann]]<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=16}}</ref> and took him to [[Voss]] where his injuries could be healed. Senya fought against a wave of Zakuulan Knights who attacked the [[Shrine of Healing]], after which she gave her life force to save her son, ending in a coma.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=1}}</ref>

[[File:Senya_Tirall_at_the_ready.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Senya Tirall with her lightsaber at the ready]]
Senya recovered just in time for the [[Assault on Odessen]], in which she and her redeemed son stood with the Alliance against her daughter, ending in Vaylin's death.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=8}}</ref> Immediately afterwards, the Alliance went to Zakuul to reclaim the [[Eternal Throne]] and stop the rogue [[GEMINI]] droids from exterminating all life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with the [[Eternal Fleet]]. Senya wielded her lightsaber as she and Arcann escorted the Alliance Commander to the top of the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]]. When the Commander's body was taken over by the spirit of [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]], Senya and Arcann entered the Commander's mind through [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]], where Senya landed one of the decisive blows against the galactic tormentor.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=9}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Sacrifice (cinematic trailer)|''Sacrifice'']] trailer Senya uses a telescopic [[Senya Tirall's lightsaber pike|lightsaber pike]] during the [[Ord Mantell massacre|ambush on Ord Mantell]].<ref name="Betrayed" /> In-game however, Senya only uses a regular lightsaber both in cutscenes and as a companion.<ref name="KOTFEchapter6" /> Both her lightsaber and lightsaber pike are available from the [[Cartel Market]].<ref name="Cartel" />
